label: TP
reason: User-provided parameter flows directly into an LDAP filter string without sanitization, enabling LDAP injection attacks. The input is concatenated into the filter expression '(&(objectclass=person)(uid='+param+'))', which is unsanitized and could allow attackers to manipulate the LDAP query structure.

evidence.note: Param extracted from request and directly interpolated into LDAP filter without validation/encoding
